description: Profit per order for an online store in Saudi Arabia after 15% VAT, platform commission, payment fees (with VAT), shipping and subscription, plus break-even price and the price for a target margin. Web version: https://irfanaslam.io/tools/saudi-ecommerce-fee-calculator

payment_percent.description: Payment fee % (mada via Zid Pay about 1, cards about 2.5, Tabby/Tamara 4-6).
